schema.text: Do you rarely walk because you feel unsafe on foot (traffic, crime or harassment)?

ar.#Do you rarely walk because you feel uns: هل تعود قلّة مشيك إلى شعور بعدم الأمان عند المشي (حركة المرور أو الجرائم أو التحرش)؟

de.#Do you rarely walk because you feel uns: Gehen Sie selten zu Fuß, weil Sie sich zu Fuß unsicher fühlen (Verkehr, Kriminalität oder Belästigung)?

en.#Do you rarely walk because you feel uns: Do you rarely walk because you feel unsafe on foot (traffic, crime or harassment)?

fa.#Do you rarely walk because you feel uns: آیا کم پیاده‌روی می‌کنید چون هنگام پیاده‌روی احساس امنیت نمی‌کنید (ترافیک، جرم یا آزار)؟

fr.#Do you rarely walk because you feel uns: Marchez-vous rarement parce que vous ne vous sentez pas en sécurité à pied (circulation, délinquance ou harcèlement) ?

hu.#Do you rarely walk because you feel uns: Azért jár ritkán gyalog, mert gyalog nem érzi magát biztonságban (forgalom, bűncselekmények vagy zaklatás)?

it.#Do you rarely walk because you feel uns: Cammini poco perché a piedi non ti senti al sicuro (traffico, criminalità o molestie)?

tr.#Do you rarely walk because you feel uns: Trafik, suç veya taciz nedeniyle yürürken kendinizi güvende hissetmediğiniz için mi nadiren yürüyorsunuz?
